fullDescription: A high-tech, futuristic design system optimized for AI infrastructure, SaaS platforms, and developer tools. Characterized by a crisp light/dark mode interplay, the style uses a technical 'Geist Mono' and 'Outfit' typography pairing. Key features include vibrant cyan (#07f1ce) and deep purple (#6507f1) accents, 3D perspective card transforms, bento-grid layouts, and sophisticated micro-interactions like text-rolling hover effects and parallax floating elements. It is suitable for high-end technical products requiring a sense of precision, speed, and modern infrastructure.

structured.summary: A sophisticated, developer-centric design system for technical SaaS products. It features a clean light-gray base with high-contrast dark sections, heavy emphasis on monospace typography for technical data, and fluid animations including parallax backgrounds and 3D perspective mockups.

style.description: The style is 'Technical Minimalism'. Typography pairs 'Outfit' (sans-serif) for primary headings with 'Geist Mono' (monospace) for technical details, numbers, and labels. The color palette is centered around a very light grey (#fcfdfc) and deep black (#0d0d0d), accented by electric cyan (#07f1ce) and royal purple (#6507f1). Animations are smooth, utilizing GSAP-style split-text reveals, parallax floating background circles, and 3D perspective transformations (perspective: 2000px). Components use a mix of sharp corners for technical inputs and soft, rounded corners (up to 3rem) for large layout containers.
style.prompt: Create a high-tech UI design using a color palette of #fcfdfc (primary background), #0d0d0d (primary text), #07f1ce (accent 1), and #6507f1 (accent 2). Use 'Outfit' for headers with negative letter-spacing (-0.03em) and 'Geist Mono' for all labels, tags, and small technical text. Implement a modular layout with large padding (10rem for large sections, 4rem for small). Key UI details: 1px light borders (#0d0d0d26), high-fidelity telemetry illustrations, and 11px thick solid separators in tertiary colors (#e8ede9). Interactive elements should feature a 'text-rolling' effect where text slides up on hover, and buttons should contain a circular arrow wrap that rotates. Add background floating circles with varying float-amplitudes (1 to 4) and parallax speeds (0.02 to 0.1) to create depth.

layout_and_structure.description: Modular section-based structure with a max-width of 1700px. The layout uses a rhythmic mix of single-column hero sections, bento-style feature grids, and vertical scrolling sliders for process steps.

prompts.prompt: Fixed header at top-center, starting at 660px width. Features a white (#fff) pill-shaped wrapper with 0.25rem radius. Contains a hamburger menu on the left, centered logo, and a 'Start' CTA on the right. On click, the nav expands into a 3-column bento-grid menu overlay showing links (Main, Company, Social) and a technical 'Changelog' tag.

Full-screen (100vh) centered hero. Features a large display heading using 'Outfit' font-size: 6rem. Background contains 6 floating parallax circles in accent colors (#07f1ce, #6507f1, #ff6e5f). Bottom-right includes a small video preview box (380px wide) with a scrolling ticker of technical system status text.

A two-column layout. Left column features an interface mockup card rotated in 3D space (rotateX(18deg) rotateY(-8deg) rotate(15deg)) with a soft 5rem blur shadow. Right column contains a 2x2 grid of feature cards with monotone SVG illustrations and small 'Geist Mono' labels.

A complex 3-column grid separated by 1px borders (#b4b5b4). Top row is a double-width card featuring a code editor component with syntax highlighting and a typewriting effect, paired with a single documentation card. The bottom row consists of three equal feature cards, each containing a centered SVG icon and small descriptive text.

A split-screen section where the left side is sticky (100vh) containing a vertical 'text-roll' indicating different sectors (e.g., Environment, Cloud, Industry). The right side is a scrollable area with large full-bleed images that have a 'slide-overlay' reveal animation as the user scrolls.

A card-based carousel. Each card (570px height) features a full-bleed portrait image. On top of the image, a bottom-aligned info box contains the client name in all-caps, their role, and a small logo. Hovering over a card triggers the quote to slide up into view.

Two-column pricing layout within a large rounded container (radius: 3rem). Features a custom monthly/yearly toggle switch. Cards use high-contrast backgrounds: one light (#e8ede9), one deep purple (#5108bd). Lists items with a custom circular tick icon in cyan (#07f1ce).

Large footer section with a 3rem border radius. Features a 3-column link grid (Main, Company, Social). The bottom of the footer contains a massive, cropped version of the brand logo (70% width) for a bold editorial finish. Includes a copyright bar with mono-spaced utility links.

special_ui_components.description: A button where text rolls upward on hover, replaced by a clone from below.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container with 'overflow: hidden'. Inner div contains two identical text layers: 'text-orig' and 'text-clone' (positioned absolute at top: 100%). On hover, translate both upward by 100% using cubic-bezier(0.455, 0.03, 0.515, 0.955).

special_ui_components.description: A dark-mode developer window used for technical demonstrations.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container with black background (#000). Header includes three colored dots (red, orange, green) on a dark-grey (#1e1e1e) bar. Content area uses cyan text (#07f1ce) in 'Geist Mono' with line numbers on the left (0.4 opacity).

special_ui_components.description: Small technical tags used for categorizing content.
special_ui_components.prompt: Rounded capsule (radius: 12.5rem). Background: #ffe4c2 or #07f1ce. Typography: 'Geist Mono', all-caps, 0.8rem. Includes a small 8px solid circle 'dot' preceding the text.
